name: mark_attendance
description: Mark a student as present or absent on a specific date. Use this when the user wants to record or update attendance for a particular day.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or 'today' for current date

name: get_attendance
description: Get complete attendance report for a student including all dates, days present/absent, percentage, and recent records.

name: get_attendance_percentage
description: Get the attendance percentage for a student along with advice on whether they need to attend more classes. Use this when user asks about attendance %, or asks if they can skip classes.

name: calculate
description: Evaluate a mathematical expression. Use for arithmetic, algebra, or any numeric calculation the user asks for.

name: calculate_cgpa
description: Calculate CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) from grades and credit hours.

grades.description: List of grade points for each subject (e.g. [9.0, 8.5, 7.0])

credits.description: List of credit hours for each subject (e.g. [4, 3, 3])

name: calculate_percentage
description: Calculate percentage from marks obtained and total marks. Also returns grade letter.

name: days_to_reach_attendance
description: Calculate how many more consecutive days a student needs to attend to reach a target attendance percentage (default 75%).

name: get_current_time
description: Get the current date and time.

name: days_until
description: Calculate how many days until a target date. Useful for exam countdowns, assignment deadlines, or event reminders.

name: working_days_between
description: Count the number of working days (excluding weekends) between two dates. Useful for calculating total class days in a period.

name: get_semester_week
description: Get which week of the semester we are currently in, given the semester start date.

semester_start.description: Semester start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: list_uploaded_pdfs
description: List all PDF files available in the uploads folder.

name: extract_text_from_pdf
description: Extract and read text content from a PDF file. Use when user asks to read, analyze, or process a PDF document.

filename.description: Name of the PDF file in uploads/ folder (e.g. 'timetable.pdf')

name: analyze_pdf_for_attendance
description: Analyze a PDF file specifically for attendance data, dates, or schedule information.

filename.description: Name of the PDF file in uploads/ folder
